units.source_text: 这个时候，阿民已经开始狼吐虎咽的吃着冒着热气的地瓜了。

en.t: By then, Amin had already begun wolfing down a steaming sweet potato.

units.source_text: 那是一种累的精疲力竭的农民才明白的吃法，阿民从抽出竹签的一侧，大口吃下去。

en.t: It was the way of eating that only farmers worn out to exhaustion could understand, and Amin took a huge bite from the side where the bamboo skewer had been pulled out.

units.source_text: 阿住则在一旁背着沉甸甸、酣睡着的广次，并不停的把地瓜放到灶火上烤。

en.t: Aju, meanwhile, stood beside him with heavy, sound asleep Hiroji on his back, constantly placing more sweet potatoes on the stove fire to roast.
